messages:
Alicia: Hey team — kicking off onboarding for Moonlit (account: moonlit.co). Goal: initial integration + 30d POC. Owners: Alicia (CS), Marco (SE), Samir (Infra). I want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a rough timeline.
Marco: Thanks — can we confirm SSO + VPC requirements? They flagged SOC2 and want VPC peering for data isolation.
Samir: I have the SSO checklist, will ping eng-infra for peering. Rough estimate: pilot infra ready in ~10 business days if nothing blocks.
Julie: From the customer side, success criteria are: 1) query embeddings latency <= 3s, 2) verified data isolation & audit logs, 3) two integrated flows in their web app by EoP pilot. Renewal risk note: if we don't show clear metrics by day 30–45 they may delay commitment.
Alicia: Noted. I'll own stakeholder comms and weekly report. Marco — can you own infra setup target for next Wed (10 business days)?
Marco: Yes, I'll start the VPC peering request and SSO config. Quick Q: pilot on hosted or reserve a small Dedicated pool?
Samir: Recommend hosted with reserved burst for pilot. We'll enable prefix caching and batching via Redwood Optimize to keep cost predictable. If throughput increases, we can flip to Dedicated.
Julie: Enablement plan: two sessions — 1) integration workshop (engineers) 2) product ops training (PMs). Also propose a short feedback survey after week 2 to capture initial UX issues.
Alicia: I'll schedule both sessions. Proposed slots: Tue 9am PT and Thu 2pm PT next week. I’ll invite Moonlit PM and Eng leads.
onboard-bot: New kickoff created: /kickoffs/moonlit-1888887776 — owners assigned: Alicia, Marco, Samir
Marco: Known risks: SSO cert rotation and IDP policy gaps could delay by 1–2 weeks. Also unclear customer SLA for data export. Action: Samir, please request their security policy doc.
Samir: Will request security doc today and loop in eng-security. I'll also add a small prompt/test-suite so we can monitor quality regressions during pilot.
Julie: Suggest we track a "pilot engagement score" (queries/day + integration completions) and set an early-retrospect trigger if score < threshold on day 20. That gives us lead time before renewal.
Alicia: :thumbsup: I'll add that metric to the weekly report template and include it in the stakeholder invite. Any blockers? If none, I'll post kickoff notes + intake form and confirm session times.
Marco: No blockers from infra; starting peering request now.
Alicia: Thanks everyone — I'll share the notes and next steps in the Moonlit thread. Ping me directly for anything urgent.
